description: This pie chart illustrates the win rate percentages for GPT-4o and LLaMA. The chart contains four slices, representing “GPT-4o” (appearing twice), “LLaMA”, and an unlabeled slice. The first “GPT-4o” slice is colored dark blue and is labeled with 19.6%, while the second “GPT-4o” slice is colored red and is labeled with 12.0%. The “LLaMA” slice is light blue and is labeled with 80.4%. The unlabeled slice is gray. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding name. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice (“LLaMA”) positioned at the right side of the chart.
